title: fix(InstantSearch): cancel scheduled operations
body: Some operations are now asynchronous, which means that we have to clean up those operations when the `InstantSearch` instance is disposed. Otherwise, the functions are called and might refer to props that have been pruned. This PR "cancel" the pending operations on `dispose`.
